keyLimits.en: No monthly or setup fee; cost is a flat 2% transaction fee across all domestic payment instruments (cards, UPI, netbanking, wallets, Pay Later, EMI), with no annual maintenance or refund processing charges. 18% GST applies on top of platform fees.
Up to 20 employees; a separate payroll product billed monthly in INR.

addOns.en: International card payments up to 3% per transaction; international bank transfers at 1% with zero forex markup.
UPI QR codes at 0.99% per transaction; Smart Collect at 1% or ₹10 per transaction, whichever is lower.
Subscription billing (card-based) at 0.9% plus platform fees; Instant Refund at ₹7.99–14.99 depending on amount.

cautions.en: Pricing is usage-based per transaction rather than a flat subscription; the 2% headline rate applies to standard domestic volume only, while international payments, UPI recurring (NACH/e-mandate), Magic Checkout and Optimizer pricing require contacting sales or are quote-based.
Enterprise/negotiated pricing is available above roughly ₹5,00,000 in monthly volume.

capabilities.en: Accepts domestic payments across cards, UPI, netbanking (72+ banks), wallets, Pay Later and EMI.
Provides payment links, hosted payment pages, payment buttons, invoices and UPI QR codes at no extra platform cost.
International payment acceptance in 135+ currencies across 180+ countries.
RESTful API, official SDKs, webhooks and a dashboard with analytics; PCI-DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance.

limitations.en: No public pricing for several products (Magic Checkout, Optimizer, UPI recurring/e-mandate); they require a custom quote request.
Payroll and payout products (RazorpayX) are separate, additional subscription products billed on their own quarterly/monthly schedules rather than included in the core payment gateway fee.

reason.en: Global payment gateway competitor with a comparable usage-based transaction fee model and broader international reach.
Cross-border payment and payout alternative for businesses needing international collections.
Business account and payment alternative for teams outside India, comparable for basic invoicing and payment collection needs.

missingAlternatives.name: PayU
missingAlternatives.reason: Major Indian payment gateway competitor to Razorpay, not in the catalogue.

missingAlternatives.name: Cashfree Payments
missingAlternatives.reason: Direct Indian payment gateway competitor with a similar usage-based fee model, not in the catalogue.

unknowns: Exact per-user pricing for RazorpayX Payroll Elite and Enterprise tiers beyond the headline monthly figure was not fully broken down on the page checked.
Whether prices shown are exclusive or inclusive of the 18% GST beyond the flat transaction fee was only confirmed for platform fees, not for all add-on products.
conflicts: The seed data suggested a flat monthly subscription price (~€15/month, 'Pro' plan); the official pricing page shows a usage-based (per-transaction) fee model instead, with no simple flat monthly consumer-facing plan for the core payment gateway. The official page was used as the source of truth.
